AMPM
How it worksDestinationsServicesAboutContact
Client sign-in
HOW IT WORKS Three stages. Pay for the one you need. Hotel discovery is a subscription on its own. Hotel assistance and complete management come after, only if you want them.
01Hotel discovery₹50,000One month from the day it activates. Renewal is a new purchase.
WHAT YOU GETSearch and filter 200 hotelsVenues, rooms, menus and photographsIndicative rates with the date they were checkedSave, compare and enquire
WHAT AMPM DOESRefreshes seasonal rates through the yearChecks availability with the property when you askMarks any rate that has gone stale
02Hotel assistanceAvailability checks are included. Negotiation, site visits, contract review and booking help are by agreement.
WHAT YOU GETAvailability for your dates, from the propertyNegotiated proposalsSite visits arrangedBooking milestones tracked
WHAT AMPM DOESTalks to the hotel for youRecords every quote and proposalBrings each proposal to you to approve
03Complete managementA management fee agreed with AMPM, separate from the subscription.
WHAT YOU GETFunctions, venues and the programmeVendor options to shortlist and selectDesigns, menus and invitations to approveGuest list, RSVP, rooms and transport
WHAT AMPM DOESRuns every vendor and the budgetKeeps both family representatives in the loopRuns the day, then closes the accounts

Plus a sample wedding, so you can see the planning side.
Questions
What happens when my month ends?Your saved hotels and your enquiries stay readable. Nothing is deleted, and renewing brings everything back.
Who creates my account?AMPM does, after we've spoken. You'll get an invitation, sign in with your mobile number, add a few wedding details and pay by card or UPI.
Are the prices final?They're indicative ranges, each with the date we last checked it. For your dates, ask for availability and the hotel team confirms with the property.

Questions
What happens when my month ends?Your saved hotels and your enquiries stay readable. Nothing is deleted, and renewing brings everything back.
Who creates my account?AMPM does, after we've spoken. You'll get an invitation, sign in with your mobile number, add a few wedding details and pay by card or UPI.
Are the prices final?They're indicative ranges, each with the date we last checked it. For your dates, ask for availability and the hotel team confirms with the property.

ABOUT AMPMOne team, from the first call to the last departure.
AMPM plans destination weddings in India. We started with hotels: knowing which ones work for a wedding, what they really cost, and who to call.That knowledge is now a database you can search yourself. When you want more, the same team runs the rest, function by function.
Dated, not guessedEvery hotel rate carries the date AMPM last checked it. When a rate is old, we say so.
Nothing without your yesDesigns, menus, proposals and invitations come to you as versions. You approve the exact version, and it doesn't change after.
Ready before it's liveNo function starts until its checklist is complete, or an authorised manager has signed off an exception.
